mapper.select: SELECT scope_key,config_subtype subtype,record_version minutes FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_REVIEW_SLA' AND is_active=1

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.ruleCode')) rule_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) contract_code FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_RULE_CONTRACT' AND JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.required')=TRUE

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.contractCode')) contract_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.sourceSystem')) source_system,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.schemaVersion')) schema_version FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='ALERT_DATA_CONTRACT'
